reply.subject: Biscuit's boarding stay is confirmed!
reply.body:
Hi Avery,

Great news — Biscuit's boarding stay at Maple Hollow Pet Lodge is confirmed for March 24 to March 27, 2027. We're so glad Biscuit will be staying with us!

If anything changes or you'd like to add any details about Biscuit's routine, just let us know. We'll be ready to welcome your pup.

Warmly,
The Maple Hollow Pet Lodge team
